# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.3.0

Version 1.3.0 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.2.0

- **Autosave**, in single player and in multiplayer. The game saves your town by itself, as the gyroid's "save and
  continue" would: every few minutes while you are outdoors and not busy (5 by default), when you go in or out of a
  building, and when you quit from the menu or close the window. Closing the game, a crash or a dead battery now
  loses a few minutes at most. Saving at the gyroid works as before. Settings → Gameplay → **Autosave** turns it off.
- **Mr. Resetti stays away by default**, since turning the game off no longer loses anything. Settings → Gameplay →
  **Mr. Resetti** brings him back (`resetti = 1` in `settings.ini`; the `disable_resetti = 0` earlier versions wrote
  does not bring him back).
- **Visiting guests are saved too.** While a guest is in the host's town, the autosave writes the guest's pockets,
  bells and letters into the guest's own town file, as the train home would; a guest whose game stops there keeps
  what it had.
- **Custom designs show as drawn.** A design worn as clothing now shows to everyone as its owner drew it (before:
  the plain shirt), and a design changed while playing updates on the others' screens. The host's designs on the
  wallpaper, carpet and house door show to guests.
- **Villagers in their houses follow the host's.** When the host and a guest are in the same villager's house, the
  villager walks about the room where the host's does, and comes into the room when the host's does.
- **More of the town follows the host**: the weather, the town tune, the museum, the noticeboard, the police
  station's lost and found, Nook's shop, the Able Sisters' display, the post office, the turnip prices, the visitors'
  events and the snowmen. What a guest changes at one of these places (a post on the board, a lost item taken,
  something bought or sold, the town tune) goes to the host and from there to everyone. Items outside that change
  without a player (a day's new weeds, things put down by villagers or events) are sent again too.
- **Players' actions show.** Other players now play the same animation as the player (picking up, shaking a tree,
  fishing, digging...), not only standing, walking and running; changed clothes show at once; and a player shows only
  to those in the same room.
- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog).
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- **Everyone in a room needs this version** (the multiplayer's messages changed; v1.2.0 cannot join a v1.3.0 room).

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Saving: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#saving). Multiplayer:
  [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer).

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.3.0-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.3.0-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.3.0-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.3.0-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

- Autosave, single player (Linux): with a save that had Mr. Resetti due and the old `disable_resetti = 0` setting,
  the town loads without him; the game saves every minute when set to 1 minute; the game killed right after an
  autosave starts again with the pockets and bells of that moment.
- Two copies of the game (Linux) with two saved towns, the guest in the host's town:
  - designs: each player wears a design of their own; each sees the other's as drawn, and the host's design changed
    mid-game shows changed on the guest;
  - a villager's house: both go into the same villager's house; the villager comes in on both screens when the host
    walks into the room and walks the same path on the guest, ending 20 to 50 units from the host's (a unit of ground
    is 40);
  - weather: rain started on the host falls on the guest;
  - the guest's autosave in the host's town writes its own town file: loaded alone afterwards, the guest's town has
    the bells set while visiting.
- All unit tests pass. The decomp changes are inside `TARGET_PC` only; the matching build gives the same hashes.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.3.0, versionCode 10300).

## Known limitations

- Other players do not hold the tool or item in their hand (their arms move as the player's do).
- Villagers in their houses follow the host's only while the host is in the same house. The island villager, insects
  and fish move on each machine by themselves; what is inside storage furniture and lamps on or off are not shared.
- The timed autosave waits until you are outdoors in the town. In your own room (whose storage furniture holds items
  outside the save) and on the island, leaving them saves, but quitting there does not.
- Multiplayer between two real, different networks and on real Android devices has not been tried much.

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
